clips.title: The story
paras: In Sen'jin Village, Ula'elek works armor for warriors across the Horde. The Darkspear smith joins forces with Thun'grim Firegaze, shaping specialized gear from traditional troll craft and trophies gathered across Kalimdor.

Ula'elek is a skilled armorsmith serving the Darkspear in Sen'jin Village. Nearby quilboar and sea crawlers threaten the coastal settlement, so the tribe needs sturdy armor and working blades. Ula'elek's skill also draws seasoned warriors from across the Horde.

Young warriors who visit Thun'grim Firegaze at his overlook in the Barrens are sent south to Sen'jin Village. The veteran trusts Ula'elek to forge Brutal Gauntlets for battle-hardened fighters. To make them, Ula'elek calls for rare materials, especially swollen, uncloven hooves from the satyrs draining the forest's magic in northeastern Ashenvale.
